verdict.rationale: The docs show a dashboard listing 'one row per worker' under Agents, implying the system tracks and supports multiple agents running concurrently on different tasks, and tasks are claimed individually so multiple agents in different checkouts could work in parallel. However, there is no explicit statement about scaling to 'many' concurrent agents, no throughput/performance guidance, and no discussion of resource limits or orchestration for large-scale parallel execution aimed at an engineering-lead's scaling concerns. Missing for 10: explicit multi-agent scaling guidance, throughput/performance claims, guidance on running dozens+ of agents, and any independent evidence of concurrent-agent operation at scale.
